name: ServingScaleCard
job: A recipe or kit card with a servings stepper where every ingredient quantity rolls to the new amount in real time, so the card does the arithmetic for the visitor
visitor_action: tap plus or minus; when the servings number is focused, arrow keys step servings (Page Up/Down by 5, Home/End to the limits)
mobile: photo stage on top with the giant servings numeral and a drag dial between 48px plus/minus buttons, basil panel below; ingredient grid narrows its columns
motion: on each change: the tick dial springs to the new value (drag it directly), the giant numeral rolls like an odometer with a vertical motion-blur smear, the factor chip pops, ingredient amounts roll in a staggered cascade with a tomato underline sweep, and the photo gives a small push-in (reduced-motion: numbers and dial swap instantly, no smear or push)

checks.render: pass (fixes: ingredient row placement, hero position in worst case, numeral clipping)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Basil: dark ground, full-bleed food photo with a huge white servings numeral as the hero, a deep basil-green panel with white type and a tabular ingredient grid, tomato accent on the dial needle and factor chip, sans throughout
notes: 2026-11-23: redesigned (batch A) to Basil (dark, photo + giant odometer numeral + drag dial + basil panel); props renamed: eyebrow -> subtitle (rendered below the title), rimColor/enamelColor -> panelColor/backgroundColor. Weakness: bright photos need the scrim; worst case without a photo leaves the hero side as a plain dark field. 2026-11-23: review fixes: servings numeral now bleeds bottom-left over the photo (~400px wide, clipped off the card's left edge; two-column wide layout removed for a full-bleed stage), nested panel replaced with a flush panel (no margin/radius/border ring), dial label clipping fixed (mask fade narrowed from 22% to 24px per side). 2026-11-23: self-hosted Inter Tight (latin 700/800 woff2 in fonts/, @font-face in the module, font-display swap); UI face 'Inter' still system-fallback.
